subject: Sharing a common R process between JGR/Deducer and RStudio?

messages.author: 1522910aab5cbf04
messages.subject: Sharing a common R process between JGR/Deducer and RStudio?
parts:
Hello group,


I just learned how to run Deducer without GUI from Dr Fellows. It's very useful for me since I mainly use R on ESS and RStudio, but do benefit from Deducer's sophisticated functions.

Little demo
http://rpubs.com/kaz_yos/deducer

Also I was wondering if it is possible to "share" a common R process between two environments, so that I can do data manipulation on the ESS (or RStudio) side, and then descriptive statistics on the dataset just created on the Deducer side (two systems accessing the same R process). That way I can utilize the best part of both systems. I tried googling, but could not come up with a good answer.


Thank you.

Kazuki Yoshida

RPubs: http://www.rpubs.com/kaz_yos/
SlideShare: http://www.slideshare.net/kaz_yos
